enriched_activities.desc: Lie face down on the bed with head on the pillow. Pull the blanket up to the shoulders. Turn onto the left side. Bend the knees. Place the left arm under the pillow. Turn onto the right side. Stretch the right arm toward the edge of the mattress. Pull the blanket back over the shoulder. Turn onto the back. Turn the head to the left. Turn the head to the right. Turn onto the left side again. Pull the blanket up to the chin. Remain still with eyes closed. Turn onto the right side. Rest the right hand on the mattress edge. Keep the legs bent. Remain motionless under the blanket.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth, and showering
enriched_activities.desc: Open the eyes. Sit up on the bed edge. Stand up. Walk to the bathroom door. Push the door open. Step inside. Press the light switch on. Turn the water heater switch on. Lift the toilet lid. Sit down. Stand up. Flush the toilet. Close the lid. Walk to the sink. Turn the tap handle. Bend over the basin. Cup both hands under the water. Splash water on the face. Rub the face with both hands. Turn the tap off. Pick up the towel from the hook. Wipe the face. Hang the towel back. Pick up the toothbrush from the holder. Turn the tap on. Wet the toothbrush under the water. Turn the tap off. Pick up the toothpaste tube. Unscrew the cap. Squeeze toothpaste onto the bristles. Set the tube down. Brush the teeth with up-and-down strokes. Turn the tap on. Cup water in the right hand. Rinse the mouth. Spit into the basin. Turn the tap off. Wipe the mouth with the towel. Open the shower door. Turn the shower valve to the left. Step under the water. Wet the hair and body. Pick up the shampoo bottle. Squeeze shampoo into the left palm. Set the bottle down. Rub the shampoo into the scalp. Rinse the hair under the water. Pick up the soap. Rub the soap over the arms and torso. Set the soap down. Rinse the body. Turn the shower valve to the right. Turn the water off. Push the shower door open. Step out. Pick up the towel. Rub the hair. Rub the arms and legs dry. Hang the towel on the hook. Walk to the door. Press the light switch off. Push the door open. Step out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed, packing work bag, and checking phone for the day's schedule
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Open the wardrobe door. Pull out a shirt from the hanger. Pull out trousers from the rail. Lay the shirt and trousers on the bed. Open the drawer. Take out underwear and socks. Close the drawer. Put on the underwear. Put on the socks. Put on the trousers. Button and zip the trousers. Put on the shirt. Button the shirt from bottom to top. Tuck the shirt into the trousers. Open the wardrobe door. Take out a jacket. Put on the jacket. Close the wardrobe door. Sit on the bed. Pick up the shoes from the floor. Put on the left shoe. Tie the left lace. Put on the right shoe. Tie the right lace. Stand up. Walk to the desk. Pick up the work bag from the chair. Open the bag zipper. Pick up the laptop charger from the desk. Place the charger into the bag. Pick up the notebook from the desk. Place the notebook into the bag. Zip the bag closed. Pick up the phone from the bedside table. Press the power button. Swipe the screen to unlock. Tap the calendar app icon. Scroll through the day's schedule with the index finger. Tap the first meeting entry. Read the entry. Press the power button to lock the screen. Place the phone into the jacket pocket. Place the bag by the door.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast with Member 2, making coffee with the kettle
enriched_activities.desc: Walk from Bedroom 1 to the Kitchen. Say "Good morning" to Member 2. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the milk carton. Take out the eggs. Set them on the counter. Close the refrigerator door. Open the cupboard door. Take out the bread package. Take out two plates. Set the plates on the counter. Close the cupboard door. Open the bread package. Take out two slices of bread. Place the slices into the toaster slots. Press the toaster lever down. Pick up the kettle from the counter. Carry the kettle to the sink. Turn the tap on. Fill the kettle with water. Turn the tap off. Carry the kettle back to the counter. Place the kettle on the base. Press the kettle power switch down. Crack two eggs against the rim of the bowl. Pour the eggs into the bowl. Pick up the fork. Beat the eggs with the fork. Set the fork down. Pick up the microwave door handle. Pull the microwave door open. Place the bowl inside. Push the door closed. Press the microwave buttons to set the time. Press the start button. Pick up the frying pan. Place the pan on the induction cooker. Press the induction cooker power button. Press the heat level button. Pour oil into the pan. Pour the beaten eggs into the pan. Stir the eggs with the spatula. Turn the induction cooker off. Slide the eggs onto a plate with the spatula. Pick up the toast from the toaster. Place the toast on the plates. Pick up the kettle. Pour hot water into the two mugs. Place two tea bags into the mugs. Stir the mugs with a spoon. Carry the plates to the table. Sit down on the chair. Say "Breakfast is ready" to Member 2. Pick up the fork. Eat the eggs. Pick up the toast. Bite the toast. Lift the mug. Sip the coffee. Set the mug down. Continue eating with the fork.

enriched_activities.activity: Final check of work bag and phone
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the chair. Carry the plate and mug to the sink. Walk from the Kitchen to Bedroom 1. Pick up the work bag from the floor by the door. Open the bag zipper. Look inside the bag. Push the notebook further down into the bag. Zip the bag closed. Pick up the phone from the jacket pocket. Press the power button. Swipe the screen to unlock. Tap the messages app icon. Tap the first unread message. Read the message. Tap the reply field. Type a short reply. Tap the send button. Press the power button to lock the screen. Place the phone into the jacket pocket. Put the jacket on. Lift the bag onto the right shoulder. Walk to the bedroom door. Pull the door open. Step out.

Walk out of the front door. Pull the door closed behind. Walk down the stairs. Step onto the sidewalk. Walk to the bus stop. Stand at the bus stop. Take the phone out of the jacket pocket. Press the power button. Check the bus arrival time on the screen. Put the phone back into the pocket. Step onto the arriving bus. Tap the transit card on the card reader. Walk down the aisle. Grab the overhead handrail with the right hand. Stand beside the seat row. Shift the bag strap on the shoulder. Get off the bus at the stop. Walk to the subway entrance. Walk down the stairs. Tap the transit card on the gate reader. Walk to the platform. Stand behind the yellow line. Step into the train when the doors open. Hold the vertical pole with the left hand. Get off the train at the station. Walk up the stairs. Walk out of the station. Walk two blocks along the street. Reach the office building. Push the glass door open. Walk to the elevator. Press the up button. Step into the elevator. Press the floor button. Step out of the elevator. Walk to the office door. Push the door open. Step into the office. Say "Good morning" to the colleagues.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office, coordinating community programs and answering emails
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the desk. Set the bag down beside the chair. Sit down on the chair. Take the laptop out of the bag. Place the laptop on the desk. Open the laptop lid. Press the power button. Type the login password on the keyboard. Move the mouse. Open the email application. Click the first unread email. Read the email. Click the reply button. Type the reply text on the keyboard. Click the send button. Open the next unread email. Read the email. Click the forward button. Type the recipient address. Click the send button. Pick up the phone from the jacket pocket. Press the power button. Tap the messages app icon. Read the incoming message from a community partner. Type a reply on the screen keyboard. Tap the send button. Place the phone on the desk. Turn to the desk phone. Lift the handset. Dial the venue number. Say "Hello, I am calling about the community program schedule". Listen. Say "Thank you, I will confirm by email". Place the handset down. Move the mouse. Open the program spreadsheet. Click a cell. Type the participant count. Click the save icon. Stand up. Walk to the printer. Pick up the printed sheets. Walk back to the desk. Sit down. Pick up a pen. Write a note on the sheet. Open the calendar application. Click the meeting slot. Type the meeting title. Click the save button.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break and eating lunch
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the chair. Push the chair under the desk. Take the wallet out of the bag. Walk out of the office. Walk down the stairs. Walk to the cafe. Push the cafe door open. Step up to the counter. Say "I would like the lunch set please". Take the wallet out. Hand the card to the cashier. Take the card back. Place the card into the wallet. Put the wallet into the pocket. Pick up the food tray. Walk to an empty table. Set the tray on the table. Pull the chair back. Sit down. Pick up the fork. Eat the rice. Pick up the spoon. Eat the soup. Lift the cup. Sip the water. Set the cup down. Wipe the mouth with the napkin. Stand up. Carry the tray to the return counter. Place the tray on the counter. Walk out of the cafe. Walk back to the office building. Push the glass door open. Walk to the elevator. Press the up button. Step in. Press the floor button. Step out. Walk to the desk. Sit down.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office, running program planning meetings and updating participant records
enriched_activities.desc: Move the mouse. Open the meeting document. Read the agenda on the screen. Pick up the notebook and pen. Stand up. Walk to the meeting room. Pull the chair back. Sit down at the table. Open the notebook. Pick up the pen. Write the meeting date at the top of the page. Say "Let's start with the program schedule". Listen to the colleague. Write notes in the notebook. Say "We need to confirm the venue by Friday". Turn the page. Write the action items. Stand up. Walk to the whiteboard. Pick up the marker. Write the timeline on the whiteboard. Set the marker down. Walk back to the chair. Sit down. Say "Thank you everyone". Close the notebook. Stand up. Walk back to the desk. Sit down. Move the mouse. Open the participant database. Click the first record. Type the updated contact number. Click the save button. Click the next record. Type the updated attendance date. Click the save button. Scroll down the list. Click the next record. Type the updated address. Click the save button. Pick up the phone. Press the power button. Tap the messages app icon. Read the message from a volunteer. Type a reply. Tap the send button. Place the phone on the desk. Move the mouse. Open the email application. Click the compose button. Type the recipient address. Type the email body. Click the send button.

Close the laptop lid. Stand up from the chair. Pick up the bag. Place the laptop into the bag. Zip the bag closed. Lift the bag onto the right shoulder. Say "See you tomorrow" to the colleagues. Walk to the office door. Push the door open. Walk to the elevator. Press the down button. Step into the elevator. Press the ground floor button. Step out of the elevator. Walk out of the building. Push the glass door open. Walk two blocks to the subway station. Walk down the stairs. Tap the transit card on the gate reader. Walk to the platform. Step into the train. Hold the vertical pole with the right hand. Get off the train. Walk up the stairs. Walk to the bus stop. Step onto the bus. Tap the transit card on the card reader. Grab the overhead handrail. Get off the bus. Walk along the sidewalk. Walk up the stairs. Reach the front door. Take the key out of the pocket. Insert the key into the lock. Turn the key. Push the door open. Step inside. Close the door.

enriched_activities.activity: Helping Member 2 prepare and cook dinner using the induction cooker and oven
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the Kitchen. Set the bag down on the chair. Say "I will help with the vegetables" to Member 2. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the vegetables. Take out the chicken. Set them on the counter. Close the refrigerator door. Turn the tap on. Hold the vegetables under the water. Rub the vegetables with both hands. Turn the tap off. Place the vegetables on the cutting board. Pick up the knife. Cut the vegetables into slices. Push the slices to the side of the board. Pick up the chicken. Place the chicken on the second board. Pick up the knife. Cut the chicken into pieces. Set the knife down. Open the oven door. Slide the tray into the oven. Push the oven door closed. Press the oven temperature buttons. Pick up the pan. Place the pan on the induction cooker. Press the induction cooker power button. Pour oil into the pan. Add the chicken pieces with the spatula. Stir the chicken with the spatula. Add the vegetable slices. Stir the contents with the spatula. Pick up the salt shaker. Shake salt over the pan. Set the shaker down. Say "The dish is almost ready" to Member 2.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner and cleaning up dishes with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Press the induction cooker power button off. Press the oven power button off. Open the oven door. Pull the tray out with both hands. Set the tray on the counter. Pick up the plates from the cupboard. Place the food onto the plates with the spatula. Carry the plates to the table. Place the plates on the table. Sit down on the chair. Pick up the chopsticks. Pick up a piece of chicken. Eat the chicken. Pick up a slice of vegetable. Eat the vegetable. Pick up the bowl. Sip the soup. Set the bowl down. Say "The vegetables turned out well" to Member 2. Continue eating with the chopsticks. Finish the food on the plate. Stand up. Carry the plates to the sink. Turn the tap on. Pick up the sponge. Wipe the plate with the sponge. Rinse the plate under the water. Place the plate into the dishwasher rack. Pick up the pan. Wipe the pan with the sponge. Rinse the pan under the water. Place the pan into the dishwasher rack. Pick up the spatula. Wipe the spatula with the sponge. Rinse the spatula. Place the spatula into the dishwasher rack. Close the dishwasher door. Press the dishwasher start button. Turn the tap off. Pick up the cloth. Wipe the counter surface. Wipe the table surface. Hang the cloth on the hook.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa and watching TV with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Walk from the Kitchen to the Living Room. Sit down on the sofa beside Member 2. Pick up the TV remote from the sofa arm. Press the power button. Point the remote at the TV. Press the channel button. Set the remote down on the sofa. Lean back against the sofa cushion. Stretch the legs out. Say "This show is good" to Member 2. Pick up the remote. Press the volume up button. Set the remote down. Cross the legs. Turn the head toward the TV screen. Pick up the phone from the jacket pocket. Press the power button. Swipe the screen to unlock. Scroll the news feed with the thumb. Press the power button to lock the screen. Place the phone on the sofa cushion. Lift the right arm and rest it on the sofa back. Watch the TV screen. Reach forward. Pick up the mug from the coffee table. Lift the mug. Sip the water. Set the mug down on the coffee table. Lean back on the sofa. Pick up the remote. Press the volume down button. Set the remote down.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa and watching TV alone
enriched_activities.desc: Turn the head toward the hallway as Member 2 leaves the Living Room. Say "Good night, see you tomorrow" to Member 2. Shift the body to the center of the sofa. Lean back against the sofa cushion. Stretch both legs onto the sofa. Pick up the remote from the sofa cushion. Press the channel button. Set the remote down on the sofa. Watch the TV screen. Pick up the phone from the sofa cushion. Press the power button. Swipe the screen to unlock. Tap the social media app icon. Scroll the feed with the thumb. Tap a photo. Press the back button. Press the power button to lock the screen. Place the phone on the sofa cushion. Reach forward. Pick up the mug from the coffee table. Lift the mug. Sip the water. Set the mug down. Pick up the remote. Press the power button to turn the TV off. Set the remote down on the sofa arm. Stand up from the sofa. Pick up the mug. Carry the mug to the Kitchen. Place the mug in the sink. Walk to Bedroom 1.

enriched_activities.activity: Reviewing community program materials and replying to messages on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Pull the chair back from the desk. Sit down on the chair. Press the desk lamp switch on. Open the laptop lid. Press the power button. Type the login password on the keyboard. Move the mouse. Open the program documents folder. Click the first document. Scroll the page with the mouse wheel. Read the program schedule. Click the second document. Read the participant list. Open the email application. Click the first unread message. Read the message. Click the reply button. Type the reply text on the keyboard. Click the send button. Open the next unread message. Read the message. Type the reply text. Click the send button. Pick up the phone from the desk. Press the power button. Tap the messages app icon. Read the incoming message. Type a reply on the screen keyboard. Tap the send button. Place the phone on the desk. Move the mouse. Click the save icon. Close the document window. Press the laptop power button. Close the laptop lid. Press the desk lamp switch off. Stand up from the chair. Push the chair under the desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking an evening shower and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the bathroom door. Push the door open. Step inside. Press the light switch on. Turn the water heater switch on. Lift the toilet lid. Stand in front of the toilet. Urinate. Flush the toilet. Close the lid. Open the shower door. Turn the shower valve to the left. Step under the water. Wet the hair and body. Pick up the shampoo bottle. Squeeze shampoo into the left palm. Set the bottle down. Rub the shampoo into the scalp. Rinse the hair under the water. Pick up the soap. Rub the soap over the arms and torso. Set the soap down. Rinse the body. Turn the shower valve to the right. Turn the water off. Push the shower door open. Step out. Pick up the towel from the hook. Rub the hair with the towel. Rub the arms and legs dry. Hang the towel on the hook. Pick up the toothbrush from the holder. Turn the tap on. Wet the toothbrush under the water. Turn the tap off. Pick up the toothpaste tube. Squeeze toothpaste onto the bristles. Brush the teeth. Turn the tap on. Cup water in the right hand. Rinse the mouth. Spit into the basin. Turn the tap off. Wipe the mouth with the towel. Press the light switch off. Push the door open. Step out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down, reading on the phone and setting an alarm
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Pull the blanket back. Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket up over the legs. Press the fan switch on. Pick up the phone from the bedside table. Press the power button. Swipe the screen to unlock. Tap the reading app icon. Scroll the page with the thumb. Read the article. Scroll to the next page. Read the next page. Tap the home button. Tap the clock app icon. Tap the alarm tab. Tap the add alarm button. Scroll the hour wheel with the thumb. Set the alarm time to 06:15. Tap the minute wheel. Tap the confirm button. Press the power button to lock the screen. Place the phone on the bedside table. Turn onto the right side. Pull the blanket up to the shoulder.

Lie on the right side with the head on the pillow. Pull the blanket up to the chin. Bend both knees. Place the left arm under the pillow. Turn onto the back. Stretch the right arm onto the mattress. Turn onto the left side. Pull the blanket over the shoulder. Turn the head toward the pillow. Remain still with eyes closed. Turn onto the right side. Pull the blanket up again. Rest the right hand on the mattress edge. Keep the legs bent. Remain motionless under the blanket. Turn onto the back. Adjust the pillow with the right hand. Remain still with eyes closed.
